Re-activating Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability and re-attaching it to Wandering Ones therefore DOES give its flying/haste grant a new, later timestamp than Tightening Coils -- directly contradicting the reference's flat claim that re-equipping 'doesn't change its timestamp.' MODERATE CONFIDENCE, flagged same-family-bias risk. 608.2g is explicit that when an effect grants permission to cast a spell during resolution, 'no other spells can normally be cast and no other abilities can normally be activated during resolution,' and no player receives priority in that window. Suspend is a special action, not casting, and special actions require priority (116.2a's pattern). So Amelia can't suspend Shivan Meteor mid-resolution -- she can only cast it for free as the trigger allows. Candidate's 'No' looks right against explicit text; reference's 'Yes' isn't supported by 608.2g as written.
